newsitem.title: CHINA: Holy ice rink, Batman! It's a washout.
newsitem.headline: Holy ice rink, Batman! It's a washout.

text.p: Thousands of Batman fans were devastated when rain turned a Hong Kong ice rink into a swimming pool, forcing the cancellation of a "Batman on ice" show.
Organisers sent home more than 4,000 spectators having failed to get the temporary ice rink ready after a downpour inundated the venue in Hong Kong's Victoria Park on Thursday night.

The stage area looked like a swimming pool, said Dale Rennie of the Australasian Entertainment Company. The rain hampered workers from clearing mud outside the venue, building a tent and spraying ice on the rink.
"This is a big disappointment but safety must come first," Rennie told the South China Morning Post newspaper.

Young fans of Batman and Robin, Sylvester the Cat, Tweetie Pie and Bugs Bunny were devastated by the washout, which even Superman would have been at a loss to solve. "Where is Batman and Mr Freezer," asked one saddened three-year-old.
The show has been behind schedule since Typhoon Victor, the worst typhoon here in 14 years, hit Hong Kong last weekend.
